summary: Largo Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a senior leadership transition on August 6, 2026. James Bannantine was appointed Co-CEO, joining Executive Chairman and Co-CEO Alberto Arias, while Daniel Tellechea retired from his Co-CEO role but remains as an advisor and board member. Bannantine brings mining turnaround experience and U.S. government relationships. The change is voluntary and orderly, not forced. No financial terms, board recommendation advisors, or structural details were disclosed. Watch for operational turnaround execution under the new leadership and potential strategic initiatives in defense and vanadium flow battery sectors.
